'''Unknown players''' are published event sheets whose Name box is blank or unreadable and whose Username does not identify the person, after facing-page and informed-identity checks. This wiki dests those 60s as [[Unknown Player]] so the lists stay on the record. A human can merge them later after interviews and research.

If the Name box has any text, dest that string as written even when it is first-name-only, last-name-only, or last-initial, then identify it. Last-name-only, nickname, and handle dests merge onto the identified stub when context, Google, or the existing wiki player database makes the match ~99.9%. [[Blank Player]] redirects to [[Unknown Player]].

== Unknown Player sheets ==

Name box blank or unreadable, Username blank or unidentifying, and the facing LS/DS pair does not identify the player. Deck titles that already say unnamed keep that title; the player dest is [[Unknown Player]].
